name: One Video, a Week of Content
tagline: Turn one recording into clips, shorts and posts everywhere.
rationale: One recording is a week of content if you cut it right. This bundle plans the main edit, carves Shorts from the moments that already worked, clips captioned highlights, writes captions that sound human, and distributes the lot across nine networks. You film once; the crew turns it into everything the platforms want.

members.name: Best Video Editor
members.reason: Plans the whole edit from your footage and hands back a review-ready cut, not a pile of trimmed files.

members.name: Shorty
members.reason: Cuts vertical Shorts from the long-form videos that already performed, so you repurpose proven winners.

members.name: Clip Bot
members.reason: Pulls captioned 16:9 highlights from any podcast and drops the file straight onto your machine.

members.name: AdaptlyPost
members.reason: Writes, queues and posts the pieces out to nine social networks from one place.

members.name: Human Copywriter
members.reason: Rewrites captions and posts so they read like you, not like a template.
